files.description: 108-page EHI export documentation PDF for Althea Smart EHR Version 3.0. Contains introduction, FHIR JSON examples for 27+ resource types (Patient, AllergyIntolerance, CarePlan, CareTeam, Condition, Device, DiagnosticReport, DocumentReference, Goal, Immunization, MedicationRequest, Observations [vitals, labs, smoking status, pediatric growth], Procedure, Claim, Coverage, ExplanationOfBenefit), CCD export instructions, contact information, and API terms of use. Documentation is examples-only with no data dictionary or schema. Generated from Google Docs, uploaded December 2024.

Bun TypeScript script that extracts FHIR JSON examples from the PDF via pdftotext. Parses section headings, extracts JSON blocks via brace-matching, and outputs structured FHIR examples with section attribution.

52 extracted FHIR resource examples across 13 resource types (Patient, AllergyIntolerance, CarePlan, CareTeam, Condition, Goal, Immunization, MedicationRequest, Observation, Procedure, Claim, Coverage, ExplanationOfBenefit). Each entry includes section name, resourceType, id, and full parsed JSON.
Extraction accounting: 28 sections discovered, 52 examples extracted, 5 parse failures documented with reasons (truncated base64 data, line-break-split UDI strings, empty sections).
Enrichment documentation: run commands, input/output descriptions, results summary, and known parsing limitations.
